messages:
claire: Morning all — heads up: sunrise deploy tomorrow 06:00 UTC. Quiet window 05:45-07:00. Posting quick preflight and pin/rollback plan. Pls ack and flag blockers.

claire: Checklist:
- Cut release branch: release/sunrise-2026-03-22
- Pin runtime image: rwd-runtime:2026-03-21-4
- Pin model: llm-8b-quant-v1 (model_id: llm-8b-20260321)
- Canary: 5% -> 25% -> 100% (30m windows)
- Rollback tag: rollback/sunrise-2026
- Kill switch: /ops/unpin

priya: Ack. I'll take model pin and verify perf tests by EOD.

ben: I'll own the canary policy + traffic shift script. Question: do we keep fallback to v2 models on latency spike?

jamal: Yes — fallback policy enabled via routing: prefer llm-8b, fallback llm-6b-fast. I'll add the circuit-breaker at 1200ms p95.

marta: Working on the release notes; need the list of feature flags toggled during launch.

claire: flags: feature.chat-streaming=on, feature.new-cache-allocator=off (we're not enabling allocator in this change).

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy created: release/sunrise-2026-03-22 by @claire at 1837654321. Commit: 0f3a9b2. Canary plan attached.

deploy-bot: Canary steps:
1) deploy canary pods with pin tag
2) wait 10m smoke + 5m metrics stabilization
3) promote to 25% if no alerts
4) full roll after 30m

ben: Logging smoke commands here for ops runbook:
```
# smoke tests
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke test"}' | jq .
# rollback
kubectl rollout undo deployment/llm-svc --to-revision=rollback/sunrise-2026
```

ops-bot: Runbook link: https://internal.redwood/sops/sunrise-deploy-2026-03-22 — includes rollback steps and monitoring playbook :link:

priya: Perf tests pass on 8b quant on EU and us-west. Latency median ~80ms, p95 ~310ms. No memory OOMs.

claire: Great. Two outstanding items: (1) confirm Dedicated pool capacity for 5%+ canary in ap-southeast? (2) approval for embedding cache flush? 

jamal: Confirmed GPU pool capacity in ap-southeast reserved (dedicated-id: ded-234). 

marta: Approving cache flush w/ note: will notify CS about transient embedding mismatch.

ben: One more: if metrics regress after we hit 25%, do we immediate rollback to v2 or dial down to 5% and triage?

claire: Plan: if metrics breach alert threshold during 25% window -> step back to 5% and investigate. If breach persists after rollback attempt or increases, full rollback to previous pinned model (llm-6b-fast) and unpin the release image.

priya: Acknowledged.

claire: Everyone please add +1 in thread when you finish preflight tasks. I'll kick at 05:40 UTC for a quick sync.

ben: +1

priya: +1

jamal: +1

marta: +1

claire: Thanks. Tagging oncall for visibility @oncall: please monitor latency dashboards 05:45-07:30.

ops-bot: Oncall rota pinged: @oncall (till 07:30 UTC) :bell:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled 05:40 UTC — preflight smoke and canary rollout will run automatically unless cancelled.

claire: If anyone spots a blocker overnight drop a message here. Otherwise we proceed with the plan.
